items.title: A Spanish envoy's lifelong journey in China
items.description: Inma Gonzalez Puy of Barcelona has for decades been living in China and fostering connections between Spain and China. Therefore, it is with some conviction that the director of the Cervantes Institute in Beijing says, "Cultures are one of the most powerful tools for connecting different societies."

items.title: Oohs and aahs are increasingly filling up the sky
items.description: Under a canopy so dense that the Milky Way seemed to spill across the heavens, a father and his son stood on the grasslands, their heads tilted back in shared awe. "It's so beautiful. I want to come back to see the stars again," says Liang Jiacheng, who traveled with his father to Ming'antu town in Zhengxiangbai Banner, the Inner Mongolia autonomous region, from Hohhot, the regional capital 400 kilometers away.

items.title: Holiday travel highlights China's transport strength
items.description: For Zhang Yang and his family in Ankang, Northwest China's Shaanxi province, this year's National Day holiday was a memorable one. On Oct 1, following the opening of the Xi'an-Ankang high-speed railway, they took a direct high-speed train from Ankang to Yan'an, a city known for its revolutionary history.
